excerpt.zh: 我们在[from.GetName]恒星系探测到了高浓度灵能能量。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]通过倾听虚境中的回声得知，这一现象是由[fromfrom.GetName]的灵能活动引起的。
excerpt.en: We have detected high concentrations of psionic energy in the [from.GetName] system. Listening to echoes within the Shroud, our [GetTelepathPlural] report that this phenomenon was caused by the psionic activities of the [fromfrom.GetName].

texts.zh: 我们在[from.GetName]恒星系探测到了高浓度灵能能量。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]通过倾听虚境中的回声得知，这一现象是由[fromfrom.GetName]的灵能活动引起的。
texts.en: We have detected high concentrations of psionic energy in the [from.GetName] system. Listening to echoes within the Shroud, our [GetTelepathPlural] report that this phenomenon was caused by the psionic activities of the [fromfrom.GetName].

texts.zh: 我们在[from.GetName]恒星系探测到了高浓度灵能能量。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]通过倾听虚境中的回声得知，这一现象是由一个外星文明的灵能活动引起的。
texts.en: We have detected high concentrations of psionic energy in the [from.GetName] system. Listening to echoes within the Shroud, our [GetTelepathPlural] report that this phenomenon was caused by the psionic activities of an alien civilization.

texts.zh: 看起来这个帝国似乎开发出了一种从强大虚境实体的意志导出灵能光环的方法，它能影响可观测现实的物质和意识。我们还观测到这些光环可以在恒星系之间传播。
texts.en: It would appear that this empire has developed methods to channel a Psionic Aura, which emanates from the Shroud and influences matter and consciousness in observable reality. Our observations demonstrate that these Auras can spread between star systems.

texts.zh: 它被称为“灵能光环”，是由一个强大虚境实体的意志发出，影响着可观测现实的物质和意识。我们还观测到这些光环可以在恒星系之间传播。
texts.en: Termed a 'Psionic Aura', it emanates from the will of a powerful Shroud entity, influencing matter and consciousness in observable reality. Our observations demonstrate that these Auras can spread between star systems.

texts.zh: 我们的数据显示，该光环有极强的负面影响。如果不加以应对，它将会快速传遍整个星系。
texts.en: Our data indicate that this Aura has extremely deleterious effects. Without countermeasures, it is projected to spread rapidly throughout the galaxy.

texts.zh: 我们在[from.GetName]恒星系探测到了一个强力的灵能光环我们的[GetTelepathPlural]称，这种来自虚境的能量发射是由[fromfrom.GetName]的灵能活动引起的
texts.en: We have detected a powerful Psionic Aura in the [from.GetName] system. According to our [GetTelepathPlural], its emission from the Shroud is caused by the psionic activities of the [fromfrom.GetName]

texts.zh: 我们在[from.GetName]恒星系探测到了一个强力的灵能光环我们的[GetTelepathPlural]称，这种来自虚境的能量发射是由一个外星文明的灵能活动引起的。
texts.en: We have detected a powerful Psionic Aura in the [from.GetName] system. According to our [GetTelepathPlural], its emission from the Shroud is caused by the psionic activities of an alien civilization.

texts.zh: 我们的数据显示，该光环有极强的负面影响。如果不加以应对，它将会快速传遍整个星系。
texts.en: Our data indicate that this Aura has extremely deleterious effects. Without countermeasures, it is projected to spread rapidly throughout the galaxy.

texts.zh: 此前，[GetScientistPlural]们观测到了一种异常的现象：遥远的恒星系带着未知来源的能量流运行，这些能量流还逐渐扩散到了其他星系。这种“灵能光环”，得名于其理论上的来源，如今发现于[from.GetName]恒星系。
texts.en: Some time ago, our [GetScientistPlural] observed an unusual phenomenon: distant star systems coursing with energy flows of unknown origin, which gradually spread into other systems. Such a 'Psionic Aura', so-called due to its theorized origin, has now been detected in the [from.GetName] system.

texts.zh: 我们的数据显示，该光环有极强的负面影响。如果不加以应对，它将会快速传遍整个星系。
texts.en: Our data indicate that this Aura has extremely deleterious effects. Without countermeasures, it is projected to spread rapidly throughout the galaxy.

texts.zh: 关于这种现象是由灵能引起的理论如果正确的话，[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]或许知道如何反制其效果。
texts.en: If theories about the psionic origin of this phenomenon are correct, the [event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] may know methods of counteracting its effects.

texts.zh: 我们在[from.GetName]恒星系探测到了一个强力的灵能光环，其来源可以追踪到[fromfrom.GetName]境内。
texts.en: We have detected a powerful Psionic Aura in the [from.GetName] system, the origin of which has been traced within the borders of the [fromfrom.GetName]

texts.zh: 我们在[from.GetName]恒星系探测到了一个强力的灵能光环，其来源可以追踪到一个外星文明境内。
texts.en: We have detected a powerful Psionic Aura in the [from.GetName] system, the origin of which has been traced within the borders of an alien civilization.

texts.zh: 我们的数据显示，该光环有极强的负面影响。如果不加以应对，它将会快速传遍整个星系。
texts.en: Our data indicate that this Aura has extremely deleterious effects. Without countermeasures, it is projected to spread rapidly throughout the galaxy.

texts.zh: 关于这种现象是由灵能引起的理论如果正确的话，[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]或许知道如何反制其效果。
texts.en: If theories about the psionic origin of this phenomenon are correct, the [event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] may know methods of counteracting its effects.

texts.zh: [from.GetName]释放出的恶毒灵能光环正在以危险的速度向整个星系散播。依据我们[GetResearchers]的观测，它已经在许多恒星系造成了恶劣的影响。
texts.en: The malevolent Psionic Aura emitted by the [from.GetName] has spread through the galaxy at an alarming rate. Judging by the observations of our [GetResearchers], it has caused ill effects across many star systems.

texts.zh: 一个未接触外星文明释放出的恶毒灵能光环正在以危险的速度向整个星系散播。依据我们[GetResearchers]的观测，它已经在许多恒星系造成了恶劣的影响。
texts.en: The malevolent Psionic Aura emitted by an uncontacted alien civilization has spread through the galaxy at an alarming rate. Judging by the observations of our [GetResearchers], it has caused ill effects across many star systems.

texts.zh: 依据我们最新的数据，它已经污染了过半由超空间航道链接着的星系。其背后蕴藏的力量似乎寻求着星系尺度的毁灭；如果不能加以制止，它可能就要得逞了。
texts.en: According to our latest data, it has encroached upon half of the hyperlane-connected galaxy. The force behind it seems intent on destruction at a galactic scale; if it cannot be counteracted, it might just succeed.

texts.zh: 如果不能快准狠地加以反制，我们将面临星系级灭顶之灾。
texts.en: Without swift and powerful countermeasures, we face galactic catastrophe.

tooltips.zh: 终末光环覆盖全星系时游戏将会结束。
tooltips.en: If the Aura of the End covers the galaxy, the game ends.

texts.zh:
轮回之终末降临了。

终末光环吞噬了整个星系。随着最后一个恒星系的沦陷，一道无法计量的能量潮爆发而出。不同维度之间的帷幕短暂消失了，虚境的灵能力突然被一整个驱逐到可接触现实中。

所有的有意识众生，无论是生物还是机械体都被抹除了。所有的行星都变成了荒芜的空壳。即便恒星也熄灭了最后一道光芒。

尽管如此，在最后一刻，我们所能感受到的只是脑海中的一个心声……

“此为万终之末。”
texts.en:
The End of the Cycle is upon us.

The Aura of the End has consumed the galaxy. As the final star system yielded to its power, an incalculable surge of energy erupted.The veil between dimensions briefly disappeared, expelling the entirety of the Shroud's psionic power into tangible reality.

All conscious beings, living or mechanical, were eradicated. Every planet became a barren husk. Even the stars gasped out their final light.

Despite this, in our final moments, all we could perceive was a voice within our minds...

"THE END OF ENDS."

tooltips.zh:
我们终结了轮回。

星系毁灭了。
tooltips.en:
We ended the cycle.

The galaxy is destroyed.

texts.zh: 结束了。
texts.en: This is the end.
